scope: Explicit full-group reapply over IPC/CLI using atomic per-actor intent/instance tokens, current receipt, shared owned runtime admission. LCD gains checked two-stage admission/Apply and actual recovery flag. No new settings/profile/receipt writes; no real hardware or GUI run.

contract.revision: FullGroupRuntime.revision is an opaque JSON string tagged by group. Control token is existing cooling/lighting RuntimeRevision pair; LCD has new RuntimeRevision(instance, generation), captured with state/recovery in one actor GroupState. Client echoes without u64/JS-number arithmetic. New actor has new random instance; reads/sensors/frame ticks do not advance desired-intent revision.
contract.lcd: Ordinary mutation admission, including failed validation/HID and preparation requests, advances intent. Checked Begin verifies expected revision, owner receipt kind/current contents, advances revision and reserves preparation ticket. Final checked Apply verifies revision again plus generation/preparation/current receipt/source before existing actor Apply. Superseded prepared source joins cleanup. Fresh instance blocks restart ABA, including equal numeric generations.
contract.control: Existing coordinator Reapply freezes both actors, validates runtime pair/current receipt, preflights and installs/applies existing saved group under barriers. Saved newer intent blocks old receipt even with fresh token; Direct RGB changes runtime token but explicit fresh retry can restore persisted bases. Unknown sealed runtime recovery is never bypassed.
contract.ownership: Shared theme_jobs permit and join_theme_job owned task span preparation, reserved actor channel/admission, result and candidate cleanup after caller/connection loss. No upload/session/archive needed for reapply. Repeated old token rejected before another Apply; read back current state after lost reply.
contract.outcome: Desired content comes from current owner readback, never old archive bytes. No CommitProfileGroup/deltas/new receipt/library revision. Known Apply failure returns desired receipt plus runtime error; fresh token needed for explicit retry. LCD recovery flag now actual bool, not unknown null. Storage and runtime readback remain separate observations.
contract.cli: profiles group reapply screen|fan-and-lighting OPERATION_ID [--device] [--expected TOKEN]. Without expected explicitly reads fresh current receipt/runtime, checks selected_content_current, echoes runtime token; no automatic retry on readback alone. Known runtime error gives nonzero exit after result output.

regressions.coverage: Extended actual private Unix RPC/DeviceManager/MockBackend flow: both group reapply endpoints; immutable device.toml/profiles.json and receipt count; old token refusal; Direct RGB supersedes token while fresh explicit reapply restores imported bases; saved fan67 prevents old receipt even with fresh revision; Screen successful retry, cross-group token rejection, invalid brightness101 supersedes old token, fresh retry works; old restart token rejected.

New actual actor Begin/checked Apply: invalid setter between stages rejects candidate without config/replacement, allowing normal background refresh. Injected frame failure preserves receipt/files; fresh retry succeeds with same bytes.
Same saved receipt, fresh actor, deliberately equal numeric generation after failed mutation. Different instance rejects old token with no output; current token succeeds with one receipt.
Actual FFmpeg prepared H264 composition queued as checked reapply; shutdown drain stops/joins candidate before actor teardown, no output or commit.

Actual Unix RPC/DeviceManager/MockBackend, private real image store blocked at catalog lock. Observe Begin consumed revision, abort caller/client, release gate, accepted Apply completes. Old token refused, storage bytes/receipt count unchanged.

Extended real CLI/private Unix socket: Screen reapply with explicit opaque token, unchanged receipt/new runtime token and rejected old token; FanAndLighting default fresh-readback reapply preserves receipt/manual0; existing archive/Inspect/import paths still pass.

checks.hardware: NOT RUN; user deferred, no physical device accessed
